purpose: One exact saved-selector-adapter reload and development comparison using the same source-only selector prompt, ordered inputs and greedy settings as the measured pretrained selector baseline. No fresh fitting or new supervision.

settings.loss: assistant JSON target plus EOS only; all prompt tokens masked

numerics.logits: only positions predicting supervised assistant JSON plus EOS; prompt labels masked

lexicalPolicy.flags: Python re.UNICODE default; no normalization or case folding.

representation.target: canonical raw selector JSON plus EOS; expanded strings for admission only
representation.teacherSupervision: provisional; not independent truth or operational facts

memoryExecutionPolicy.causeQualification: The inspected selector fit completed66 updates with exact save/base/resource proof. Quality is unmeasured; one separate exact saved-adapter reload now tests the fixed development criterion against retained pretrained selector output.
memoryExecutionPolicy.checkpointing: Non-reentrant recomputation for deterministic frozen projection/loss; preserve stochastic decoder/LoRA RNG behavior. No target truncation, per-chunk reweighting or independent example splitting.
memoryExecutionPolicy.continuation: One separately frozen saved-adapter development reload only, with no optimization. Preserve the accepted fit-only numerical/memory policy as provenance; ordinary unchanged SDPA generation is used. Stop on failure and return exact raw outputs and accepted host comparison.
memoryExecutionPolicy.equivalence: Retain the accepted 64-token head-loss and reclamation controls. One small contained attention fixture compares the original pinned full causal SDPA output and Q/K/V gradients with the 128-query implementation, including the offset second block and 7-query final block. Use the predeclared attentionControlBeforeFit tolerances; preserve/restore RNG and persistent state. Failure returns the control evidence before any fit; no relaxed tolerance or retry.
memoryExecutionPolicy.implementation: One decoder forward; select the same assistant-predicting hidden positions; frozen lm_head projection and float32 summed cross-entropy in 64-token checkpointed chunks; sum chunk losses and divide by exact total supervised tokens including EOS. Avoid storing full vocabulary logits/float copy/backward buffers.
memoryExecutionPolicy.instrumentation: Retain accepted finite-loss, before/after cache, per-example and cumulative native/GPU observations. Record the bound attention implementation/control hash, block count and maximum query block length for actual examples, with truthful executed-update/progress counts and original exceptions. No peak resets or acceptance of a transient cap breach.
memoryExecutionPolicy.interUpdateReclamation: After each completed scaler/optimizer update and scalar progress capture, set adapter gradients to None, release all finished-step tensor/graph references including the norm scalar, collect unreachable Python cycles, synchronize as necessary and empty only unused CUDA allocator cache before the next example. Apply the same unused-cache reclamation after model/base-digest setup before the first example. Keep the model, trainable parameters, Adam moments, scaler, encoded examples, epoch order and RNG states alive and unchanged. Never free live storage, reset peaks or recreate/move the optimizer/model between examples.
memoryExecutionPolicy.preBackwardReclamation: After the existing finite loss and cumulative bound observation and before scaler.scale(loss).backward(), synchronize and release only unused cache using the existing leaf release_unused_cache routine. Keep ids/labels/target/selected/hidden/loss and all saved autograd/checkpoint state live and connected; do not detach, zero gradients, run the decoder again, or delete graph references here. Preserve the existing post-setup and post-update reclamation.

queryChunkedAttention.causalMask: For block start s, allowed key k satisfies k <= s + localQueryIndex. Use explicit absolute-position boolean causal mask with is_causal=False for each rectangular SDPA call. Never use a fresh is_causal=True triangle per block, drop earlier context, split source examples or reweight loss.
queryChunkedAttention.gradients: Keep Q/K/V connected, include all query outputs, aggregate K/V and adapter gradients through autograd; no detach or manual approximate gradient. Persistent optimizer/scaler state and masks/denominators unchanged.
queryChunkedAttention.installation: Use a fit-scoped Qwen-local attention-interface override and restore it in finally; do not alter the global shared registry, third-party source bytes, baseline or reload/generation path.
queryChunkedAttention.primitive: Existing pinned torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention, math backend with unchanged float32 math intermediates for float16 inputs; no new attention algorithm, kernel dependency, precision option or parameter.
queryChunkedAttention.schedule: Compute original complete Q/K/V and RoPE through the original Qwen attention forward; process only the query axis in contiguous blocks, retaining all original K/V positions and grouped-query semantics. Non-reentrant RNG-preserving checkpoint each SDPA block, then concatenate in original query order and use the original output projection. Keep the existing decoder checkpointing and one logical decoder forward.
queryChunkedAttention.scope: Fit-only, exact loaded Qwen2 attention instances, batch1 equal full query/key lengths, 14 query heads/2 KV heads/head dimension64, no past cache or sliding window, zero attention dropout and no output_attentions. Fail unsupported masks/shapes/kwargs honestly instead of silently falling back. Preserve model configuration/weights and all q/v adapters/dropout/RNG.

attentionControlBeforeFit.qualification: Technical objective-preservation fixture only, never source truth or model quality.
attentionControlBeforeFit.reference: Original pinned Transformers SDPA causal route, same Q/K/V and scalar objective, no candidate-derived reference.
attentionControlBeforeFit.toleranceReason: Tight double-precision algebra check; CUDA permits fp16 GEMM/reduction and grouped K/V gradient-accumulation rounding with unchanged float32 math/loss. No bitwise equality claim for the full fit.
requirements: all Q/K/V gradients finite and within tolerances
all query outputs preserved in order
absolute causal offsets and final short block covered
no model parameter or optimizer/precision changes

lengthPolicy: Measure both exact source-only prompts before loading the model. Preserve all input tokens; refuse above2048 tokens without truncation or changed input/prompt. Greedy generation is bounded at768 new tokens; retain raw output and token-limit outcome without repair/retry.
acceptance: Require exact saved adapter binding/tensor reload, frozen prompt/input/representation pins, retained raw/preflight/expanded-or-rejected outputs, original cumulative Job/CUDA bounds and complete output/guard/closure/cleanup acceptance. Compare only accepted expanded outputs by original unique(role,state,literal,unit) signatures against the unchanged six host-only expectations. Report syntax/schema/raw-selector/expanded/model validity separately, accepted/emitted/unique/correct counts, precision(null if no accepted signatures), coverage, no-canonical-target abstentions and resources/latency.
formatQualification: Exact selector decoding establishes source copying, not semantic correctness. This fit tests a hypothesis; fitting completion or decreasing loss cannot establish usable coverage. No native IFC/absent/null-state training coverage is added.
ownership: One learner owns the GPU/model phase. Execute only from the frozen absolute learner checkout. Existing source/runtime/model/dependencies/teacher/originals/fit/old runs are read-only. Write only new private stage/output/host comparison/receipts and new student/selector-reload-v1.json and selector-reload-v1.md evidence. No code edits, installation/acquisition, host configuration, staging/frontend/shared gateway/API/catalogue/service/Docker/volume/provider/deployment action.
teacherFeedback: Teacher remains idle; no development/evaluation source contents, expectations or predictions may be sent to it.

settingsRequired.observation: Verify supplied never/danger-full-access and report exposed actual settings honestly. Dispatch exposes no per-turn tier control.

continuation: Exactly one fresh reload stage and one contained inference phase, then one short host-only comparison after accepted guard/output/cleanup. Required stager fit-proof admission is allowed; do not duplicate manual CPU/security/source campaigns or rerun any prior model phase. On any pin/token/tensor/resource/output/cleanup failure preserve artifacts and return the exact exception without retry or broad repair. Commit only the new evidence pair and callback to the coordinator, then stop. No second fit, training diagnostic, sweep, output repair, evaluation opening or promotion.
inferencePolicy: Reload the original local safetensor base plus exactly the accepted96-tensor saved adapter. Require all parameters frozen and exact saved/loaded tensor equality. Original SDPA generation; no fit-only attention override, training inputs/targets/teacher material/expectations/canonical targets in the contained phase. Whole-response strict JSON/schema/range expansion followed by unchanged semantic/citation/state/family validation; no repair, fence stripping or partial credit.

hostComparison.metricDefinition: On the host after guard/output/cleanup acceptance, compare only accepted expanded outputs with unchanged source-supported expectations by the original (role,state,literal,unit) signature, per example. Report unique accepted signatures/correct intersection/expected denominator, emitted claim count, source-native precision (null if none), coverage and valid no_canonical_targets abstentions separately. Report raw JSON/schema/range/expanded-validation counts and rejection stages separately. Rejected expansions receive zero accepted-claim credit. Do not use the old raw-text citation summarizer on selector arrays.
hostComparison.method: One short host-only in-memory comparison may write a new summary receipt outside the contained model stage. Do not change the frozen executable code before staging or edit existing summaries. Pin expected bytes before reading; never place expectations in the contained inputs/code/prompt.
hostComparison.qualification: Two related IFC development examples; exact source spans and validator acceptance are not independent semantic accuracy. No natural conflict accuracy or canonical matching/generalization/operational qualification is supported.

developmentCriteriaBeforeAnyLaterEvaluat.nullAndAbsentStates: Preserve distinct source-supported null and absent states; no invented values.
developmentCriteriaBeforeAnyLaterEvaluat.resourcesAndCleanup: Existing measured caps and containment/cleanup acceptance all pass.
developmentCriteriaBeforeAnyLaterEvaluat.interpretation: Unchanged predeclared tiny development criteria. This reload cannot authorize another fit, opening evaluation or promotion automatically; return actual results for the next bounded decision.

metadataInterpretation: Legacy reload result flags teacherOutputsUsed=True and fitPerformed=True describe the saved adapter provenance; fitPerformedInThisProcess=False and teacherInputsInReload=False describe this phase. Do not claim training or teacher targets entered the reload. Preserve frozen code/outputs and explain scope in the new receipt.
